title: Sunday · the Rain, 2006
logline: Ninth January. The garage window from inside, rain on the glass, three jars on the sill. The first time the sill is drawn.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the casement window from inside, rain on the glass in watercolor resist, the alley a blur, three jars on the sill: brushes, nibs, and a sand dollar — no. Two jars. The sand dollar isn't found until 2013. Brushes and nibs.

image.prompt: a small wood-mullioned casement window seen from inside a garage studio, rain streaking the glass in watercolor resist, the alley beyond a gray blur, two jars on the sill holding brushes and pen nibs, no figures
image.notes: Two jars. The third (the sand dollar) arrives in 2013. Don't draw it.

panels.name: The sill

panels.composition: Tier 2: the drafting table below the window, the lamp on, the dog bed under it with the dog in it, the chair empty.

image.prompt: a drafting table under a rainy window with its green lamp on, the chair empty, a gray-muzzled dog asleep in a braided bed beneath, watercolor

panels.name: The chair

panels.composition: Tier 3: the same, later, the lamp off, the window's blue light on everything. The dog hasn't moved. Silent.

image.prompt: the same drafting table with the lamp off and cold blue rain-light from the window falling across it, the dog still asleep beneath, watercolor, no words
image.notes: Lamp on, then lamp off: the Empty Chair's device, eight years early, with the dog still in the bed.

panels.name: Blue

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The garage sill and the lamp-on/lamp-off device, planted eight years before 'The Empty Chair.'
